text:
ivy: quick report — bringing up shoreline-14b int8 quant. reproducible divergence vs fp16 when logical context crosses 43072 tokens. minimal repro attached.

noah: can you paste the failure snippet?

ivy: ran on single A100, seed=9001, seq=43100. log:
```
ERR: rope_phase_mismatch at global_pos=43072 layer=9 expected 0x2a7c got 0x2a7b
INFO: prefill flush at 43072, kv_phys_idx=43080 pad_prefix=8
DEBUG: int8_pack_pad=8 applied for shard alignment
```

pat: interesting. disabling cache (`--no-cache`) removes mismatch?

ivy: yes, `--no-cache` matches fp16. with cache enabled mismatch is deterministic at the token that crosses 43072.

ops-bot: test-run: 2951234575 by ivy — shoreline-14b / int8 / cuda:0 / seq=43100 / dump-kv=1. Result: mismatch at layer=9 kv_global_idx=43072 pad=8.

noah: that pad offset looks familiar — we added pack padding for 8-byte lane alignment in commit b2f7e3. likely physical buffer indices include pad but rotary math still uses logical positions.

pat: quick triage plan: (1) add tiny failing unit test in tests/longctx/test_shoreline_kv_pad.py with a 43k prefill and assert per-layer rope parity; (2) prototype fix: compute logical_pos = phys_pos - pad_prefix[layer] before applying rotary phase in runtime/rotary.cc; (3) add nightly long-window parity job for quant models at [8k,32k,43k,64k].

ivy: I've added the reproducer script and KV dumps to a draft PR. linking in thread.

noah: bisect indicates b2f7e3 introduced `int8_pack_pad=8` in runtime/pack.cc. earlier commit a9d1f2 doesn't reproduce.

pat: short-term workaround for Private installs: runtime config `int8_pack_pad=0` avoids the regression (perf tradeoff ~2%). We'll document as a temporary knob.

ops-bot: todo added ENGML-4102 create failing test + bisect notes — assigned pat.

ivy: also note: ropescale thresholds were conditionally applied in the int8 wrapper; we should audit all conditional codepaths that touch rotary math to avoid similar off-by-pad issues.

noah: agreed. after the patch we should run token-diff across dumps and a quick LLMQA long-window sweep to detect quality drift. if drift > 1.5% revert the perf change.

pat: opening PR with failing test + suggested patch to subtract pad_prefix. will request review from noah.

ivy: thanks team. adding a line to the quant onboarding checklist: "run longctx KV parity up to model max window + 1k" so we exercise the fencepost regions. :white_check_mark:
